// REQ: LANG-2251 LANG-2252 LANG-2253 LANG-2254
/* Greeter */
class Greeter {
  string name;
  Greeter(const string &in n) { name = n; }
  int greet(int times) {
    for (int i = 0; i < times; i++) print("Hello, " + name + "!\n");
    return name.length();
  }
}
void main() {
  Greeter@ g = Greeter("angel");
  if (g.greet(2) > 0 && true) print("" + 0x1F);
}
